name: Crosscheck
tagline: Audits your marketing claims through two independent reviewers
description: Before a page or pitch goes out, every load-bearing claim is walked past two separate reviewers: one argues the reasoning, the other chases live sources. Each claim returns graded as backed, shaky, contradicted or unverifiable, with suggested repairs for the ones that fail.
author: the_Arow_H
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
